body:
PROBLEM. The issue-lanes skill (`.claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md`, lane template `.claude/skills/issue-lanes/references/lane-prompt.md`) was written for one run on one machine. Selection (SKILL.md section 1) reads `gh issue list` and writes nothing to GitHub until a lane opens its PR, and the 'one lane per package' rule is enforced only within a single batch. Two runs started on two machines therefore select the same issues, or different issues in the same package, and duplicate a full lane (worktree, mutation gate, cross-model review, possible attestation).

DESIGN. The operator controls start times, so runs never start within seconds of each other. The design is a plain GitHub label plus a claim comment, without claim tokens, a tiebreak, a lock service, or auto-reclaim; the residual same-second race is documented in the skill rather than closed.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR (all of it is skill prose and copy-pasteable commands; there is no code).
1. Label. The label is named exactly `WIP`. Section 0 (Preconditions) gains a check that it exists and, if absent, the create command `gh label create WIP --description "claimed by an issue-lanes run" --color FBCA04`.
2. Stale sweep, section 0. List open issues labelled `WIP` that have no open PR referencing them and whose most recent claim comment (item 4) is older than 48 hours. Print them as a warning for the operator to clear by hand. The skill never removes a label it did not add in the same run.
3. Selection, section 1. (a) The `gh issue list` jq excludes any issue carrying `WIP`. (b) Build a TAKEN-PACKAGES set from two sources: the `packages/<pkg>/` prefixes of files changed by every open PR (`gh pr list --state open --json number,files`), and the `package:` field of the claim comment on every open `WIP` issue. (c) The existing 'one lane per package' rule is extended: a candidate whose package is in TAKEN-PACKAGES is skipped.
4. Claim, section 1, immediately after finalists are chosen and BEFORE any worktree, ticket, or stale-premise close: for each finalist run `gh issue edit <n> --add-label WIP` and post one comment of the exact form `issue-lanes claim — package: packages/<pkg>, host: <hostname>, <ISO-8601 UTC timestamp>`; then re-read the issue's labels and confirm `WIP` is present before proceeding. A premise-stale issue (section 1 rule 5) is claimed the same way before it is closed.
5. Release on success: the label stays on through the PR; `Closes #<n>` closes the issue on merge. No removal step.
6. Release on failure, lane prompt. A lane that stops WITHOUT opening a PR (genuine blocker, review loop not converged at the cap, premise found stale) runs `gh issue edit <n> --remove-label WIP` and comments the reason. If `gh` is denied by permissions it reports the exact commands, as it already does for push/PR.
7. Close-out, section 5. For every lane that ended without a PR, the parent verifies `WIP` is gone and removes it itself if not.
8. Gotchas section gains one bullet stating the guarantee and its limit: the label prevents collisions between runs started minutes apart; it is a check-then-act and is NOT safe for runs started within seconds; stale labels are flagged, not reclaimed.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Label precondition and create command present. verify: `grep -c 'gh label create WIP' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md` >= 1
- AC2 Stale sweep with the 48-hour threshold present in section 0. verify: `grep -c '48 hours' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md` >= 1
- AC3 Selection excludes WIP and builds the taken-packages set from open PR files and claim comments. verify: `grep -c 'TAKEN-PACKAGES' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md` >= 2 and `grep -c 'gh pr list --state open --json number,files' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md` >= 1
- AC4 Claim step adds the label and the exact claim comment form before worktrees. verify: `grep -c 'gh issue edit <n> --add-label WIP' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md` >= 1 and `grep -c 'issue-lanes claim — package:' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md` >= 1
- AC5 Lane prompt releases the label when stopping without a PR. verify: `grep -c 'remove-label WIP' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/references/lane-prompt.md` >= 1
- AC6 Close-out verifies release. verify: `grep -c 'remove-label WIP' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md` >= 1
- AC7 Guarantee/limit bullet present. verify: `grep -c 'within seconds' .claude/skills/issue-lanes/SKILL.md` >= 1
- AC8 Repository label exists. verify: `gh label list --search WIP --json name --jq '.[].name'` prints `WIP`
- AC9 Workspace suite unaffected. verify: `npm run preflight` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: race-safe claiming (tokens, tiebreaks, leases); auto-reclaiming stale labels; any change to `.claude/skills/backlog-groom/`; the `adlc ticket complete` push flow; provider-quota coordination across machines; any file under `packages/`, `plugins/`, `scripts/`, or `apps/`.
title: issue-lanes: claim selected issues with a WIP label so concurrent runs on different machines do not collide
